content.short: Call of Odin's Chosen is a Viking themed play to earn game running on Monad and TON.
content.description: Call of Odin's Chosen is a Viking themed play-to-earn game running on Monad and TON, playable through a Telegram mini app. Players raid, collect equipment and earn the COC token, which releases 42 percent of supply in the first month and halves every thirty days after. Progression covers equipment slots, honor titles and an attendant collection, each unlocked with in-game diamonds. The team counted more than 300,000 pre-registrations ahead of launch.
content.meta: A pirate play-to-earn title on Monad and TON with a hard cap on reward emissions.
